# Calculate daily returns
daily_returns = pivot_close.pct_change().dropna()

# Calculate mean returns and standard deviations (volatility)
mean_returns = daily_returns.mean()
std_devs = daily_returns.std()

# Calculate the Sharpe ratio assuming a risk-free rate of 0
sharpe_ratios = mean_returns / std_devs

# Calculate the covariance matrix of returns
cov_matrix = daily_returns.cov()

# Function to calculate the portfolio performance
def portfolio_performance(weights, mean_returns, cov_matrix):
    returns = np.dot(weights.T, mean_returns)
    std_dev = np.sqrt(np.dot(weights.T, np.dot(cov_matrix, weights)))
    sharpe_ratio = returns / std_dev
    return returns, std_dev, sharpe_ratio

# Number of assets
num_assets = len(mean_returns)

# Generate random portfolios
num_portfolios = 10000
results = np.zeros((3, num_portfolios))
weights_record = []

for i in range(num_portfolios):
    weights = np.random.random(num_assets)
    weights /= np.sum(weights)
    weights_record.append(weights)
    portfolio_return, portfolio_std_dev, portfolio_sharpe_ratio = portfolio_performance(weights, mean_returns, cov_matrix)
    results[0,i] = portfolio_return
    results[1,i] = portfolio_std_dev
    results[2,i] = portfolio_sharpe_ratio

# Convert results array to DataFrame
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results.T,columns=['ret','stdev','sharpratio'])
results_df['weights'] = weights_record

# Locate the portfolio with the highest Sharpe Ratio
max_sharpe_idx = results_df['sharpratio'].idxmax()
max_sharpe_allocation = pd.DataFrame(results_df.loc[max_sharpe_idx,'weights'],index=pivot_close.columns,columns=['allocation'])

# Display the results
print("Max Sharpe Ratio Portfolio Allocation:")
print(max_sharpe_allocation)
